scope: Explicit original-storage record members; local evidence, not release certification
configuration: api.memberFunctions[].kind=value with semantics.valueParameters for the exact receiver

assertions: Three imports with Runtime package/source; source uses static facade, single file and nested carriers
LibraryImport consumer compiles with actual SDK generators and warnings as errors
Original in/ref-this forwarding, exact field count and explicit context
Complete carrier mutation guard and field/size/type/overload collision refusal
Unknown record role, unknown/contradictory retention, ownership lifetime, output-only, const-write, volatile/unknown qualification and over-alignment retain raw imports with omissions
Contracts-only projection forbids a value receiver object name, release domain or pointer-alias substitution

native.scope: Windows x64 MSVC/CoreCLR, FunctionTable/DllImport/LibraryImport, Runtime package/source; source static facade, single-file output and nested carrier
assertions: Six exact C value operations execute through generated members without native factory or destructor
Stack and managed-array values retain native size and field offsets
Readonly in-this passes the same address as an aliased field without a defensive copy
ref-this, a field reference and overlapping Span preserve native-visible identity
Receiver selection works at a nonzero native parameter index
Independent contexts operate on caller-owned values while a disposed context rejects new calls
Native atomic controls keep the complete native frame parked through forced compacting GC; its retained address matches the original array element
Gate release occurs in finally and the native operation is joined with a deadline before reporting fixture failures
Raw pointer signatures remain callable and the explicit static facade still forwards ordinary ref operations

remainingLimits: Named standalone pointer wrappers are a separate presentation capability.
Status/owned results, callbacks and async value-receiver combinations require independently checked plans.
The address borrow is synchronous, non-null and explicitly nonretaining; it supplies no ownership or native validity after return.
NativeAOT, browser Wasm, other operating systems and final physical packages require their own same-revision validation.
